---
title: "Monte Carlo Verification of the Normal Distribution MGF"
author: "Anthony Morciglio"
date: "10/01/2025"
output: html_document
---

```{r gamma-function-demo, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
set.seed(123)

# Parameters of the Normal
mu <- 1.0
sigma <- 2.0
n <- 1e6    # number of simulations

# Simulate Y ~ Normal(mu, sigma^2)
Y <- rnorm(n, mean = mu, sd = sigma)

# Define t values
t_vals <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = 11)

# Monte Carlo estimates
mc_est <- sapply(t_vals, function(t) mean(exp(t*Y)))

# Theoretical MGF
theo_mgf <- exp(mu * t_vals + 0.5 * sigma^2 * t_vals^2)

# Combine results
results <- data.frame(
  t = t_vals,
  MonteCarlo = mc_est,
  Theoretical = theo_mgf
)

results

ggplot(results, aes(x = t)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = MonteCarlo, color = "Monte Carlo"), size = 3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Theoretical, color = "Theoretical"), size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Monte Carlo"="blue", "Theoretical"="red")) +
  labs(title="Monte Carlo Verification of the Normal MGF",
       x="t",
       y="M_Y(t)",
       color="Legend") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```
